explanations: child() calls Object.assign(this.bindings, fields), which writes the new fields into the parent's own bindings object and returns it. Every child of the root logger therefore shares and mutates one object. Each new request overwrites requestId, rideId and riderId for the root and for every in-flight request, so lines are stamped with whichever request started last, and the service's own lines pick up request fields too. The fix builds a fresh object ({ ...this.bindings, ...fields }), so each child inherits the parent's context without changing it.
